featured_reviews.name: Saili Amberkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of booking MVM BANQUETS for my wedding, and I can't praise it enough. The team was incredibly professional and accommodating, ensuring every detail was meticulously planned and executed. The staff were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and there was more than enough to satisfy all our guests. We received numerous compliments on the meal, which made the day even more special.

The interiors of the banquet hall are stunning, with elegant and tasteful decor that created the perfect ambiance for our celebration. The decor team did an exceptional job, transforming the space into a fairy tale setting that exceeded our expectations.

A special mention goes to Sandeep and Nishita, whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable. Sandeep was incredibly attentive to every detail, ensuring that everything ran smoothly and seamlessly. His professionalism and dedication were evident in every interaction. Nishita's creative touch and impeccable taste added a unique flair to our event, making the ambiance truly magical.

Also, Nitin and Mohit were incredibly attentive and responsive, addressing all of our concerns and requests with professionalism and a genuine desire to make our day special.

Overall, MVM provided an unforgettable wedding experience. A big thank you to Sandeep, Nishita, Mohit, and Nitin for their outstanding service and for making the day so special. Highly recommended!

One of the standout features of Sunderbai Hall is its **prime location**—literally a stone’s throw away from Churchgate station, making it easily accessible by train, cab, or even on foot if you're already in the Fort/Marine Lines area. The moment you step out of the station, a short walk brings you to this quiet, convenient venue nestled amid the city's hustle.

Events here are generally **well-organized** with good crowd management, clear signage, and polite staff who ensure everything runs smoothly. There’s always a buzz of activity, but never chaos—an excellent balance!

What’s even better is that most events here are **free to enter** or charge a nominal fee. Perfect for casual browsing or even planned shopping trips, especially if you're into **book bargains, ethnic fashion, artisanal crafts, or curated home goods**.

In a city like Mumbai where space is a premium, **Sunderbai Hall stands out as a reliable and versatile venue** that consistently delivers quality experiences. If you're in the area, keep an eye out—you never know what treasure trove awaits inside.

📍**Location tip:** Exit Churchgate station from the main gate, take a left, and it's right around the corner. Super easy to find!

featured_reviews.name: Rehan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Wedding Venue Experience – Absolute Mismanagement and Broken Promises

If I could give Sawai Banquet Hall zero stars, I would.

What was supposed to be one of the most important and memorable days of our lives turned into a stressful and frustrating experience because of the venue's complete lack of professionalism, planning, and accountability. The management made countless promises before taking our booking, but when it came time to deliver, they failed on almost every front.

We were explicitly assured that the afternoon event would end by 4:30 PM and that all the venues we had booked Sawai Banquet, Tiara, Ahana, and Vatika  would be fully handed over by 5:30 PM. However, when we arrived at 6:15 PM, the previous event's guests were still vacating the premises. The venue was nowhere close to being ready. Decorations had not been completed, arrangements were unfinished, and there was complete chaos instead of preparation.

The bridal room was another disappointment. The air conditioning was not working, making it extremely uncomfortable for the bride and family members during an already hectic schedule.

The washrooms were dirty, unhygienic, and clearly had not been cleaned properly despite repeated assurances regarding venue cleanliness. For a premium wedding venue, this level of neglect is simply unacceptable.

Several arrangements that were specifically promised during discussions were never provided. Direction boards for the Veg and Non-Veg food sections were missing. The Nikah setup was not arranged as committed. Guests were left confused and inconvenienced due to the lack of basic event coordination.

The situation only worsened during the reception. Even by 8:00 PM, the special reception entry that had been promised was still not ready. Chairs and sofas were covered in dust and looked as though they had not been cleaned before guests arrived. It was embarrassing to host guests under such conditions.

Parking arrangements were another complete failure. We were charged for parking facilities for approximately 30 vehicles and were informed that the venue had a tie-up with Amar Theatre to accommodate additional parking. On the wedding day, we were suddenly informed that the theatre was undergoing demolition and no parking was available. No alternative arrangements were made, leaving our guests to struggle unnecessarily.

What is most disappointing is not just the poor execution, but the complete gap between what was promised and what was delivered. The management seems far more interested in making commitments during the sales process than actually fulfilling them on the event day.

This venue excels at making promises and fails at keeping them.

Our wedding day should have been filled with joy and celebration. Instead, we spent hours dealing with delays, missing arrangements, poor cleanliness, and management failures.

I would strongly advise anyone planning a wedding or major event to avoid Sawai Banquet Hall unless they are prepared for last-minute surprises, broken commitments, and unnecessary stress.

Tall promises. Zero delivery. Zero accountability. Absolutely not recommended.

The Bombay Presidency Radio Club, established in 1928 and located at 157, Arthur Bunder Road in Colaba, Mumbai, is a historic, premier club situated on the Arabian Sea near the Gateway of India. It is a private members' club known for its seaside views, banquet halls, and, historically, as the site of India's first radio broadcast.
Key Details about The Bombay Presidency Radio Club:
Location: 157, Arthur Bunder Road, Apollo Bandar, Colaba, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400005.
History: Founded on March 8, 1928, it originated from radio, sailing, and, in June 1923, hosted the first-ever radio broadcast in India.
Features: Offers a "sea-facing" experience with amenities like banquet halls, wedding lawns, a pool, and lounging areas.
Venues: Includes the RC Lounge, Paradise Lawn, Presidency Lounge, and a poolside area, which can be booked for events.
Membership & Access: The club is a private, member-only, guarantee-and-association company. As of Oct 2024, the ordinary membership fee is ₹17,50,000 plus taxes.
The club is renowned for being a "second home" for members, providing a mix of leisure, culture, and social events, often referred to as a "hidden gem" due to its tranquil, breezy, and scenic location in South Mumbai.
I will recommend this place to other people and tourists, visiters.

A heartfelt appreciation also goes to Head Chef Hemant Sawant, whose culinary expertise truly reflected in the taste and quality of the dishes served. From the luxurious ambiance and beautiful décor to the exceptional food and smooth management, every aspect of our event at The Legacy Banquet was handled with great professionalism and dedication. We would highly recommend this venue to anyone looking for a place that offers elegance, quality and outstanding service with wide variety of food.

I truly feel that when my daughter grows up and looks back at the pictures and memories of her celebration, she will say, “My parents chose a place that made my special day look like a dream.”

Once again a big Thank you to the entire team of Legacy Banquets 🙏🏻🙌🏻

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an Aircondition Banquet Hall located inside Saisa Club, Bandra. It is a nice place to have your family functions.
The hall can accommodate about 100 guests with table seating and much more with theatre style seating.
The service is good and the staff are friendly and helpful.
Note that washrooms though clean and well maintained are not on the same floor, there is a lift for elderly people to use.
Parking is also not available here and being a Paali Hill junction it's mostly crowded and finding parking can be a task.
